synopsis: A prequel to the Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED FREEDOM movie. After the collapse of the Destiny Plan proposed by Dullindal, which would have decided people's fates based on genetics, Cagalli, the chief representative of the Orb United Emirates, has been working to bring about a peaceful new order by establishing a global peace monitoring agency called COMPS (Pronounced Compass). C.E.74. The great war is over, but Shinn has yet to decide what course he should follow. Then a mobile suit which has survived many past battlefields is transferred from ZAFT to COMPS's temporary base on Onogoro Island. That night, however, the Strike Freedom Gundam is stolen by persons unknown. To stop the situation from escalating, to recover the stolen machine, and for the sake of everything they must protect, Shinn and his comrades once again throw themselves into battle... (Source: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM Site)

title: ZAN
synopsis: During Japan’s Warring States period, the warrior ZAN was locked in a fierce battle at Azuchi Castle. Guided by the mysterious voice of a young girl, he steps beyond time and space into another world—a realm where he must face powerful rivals and monstrous beings known as Tropes. RIKKA, the ruler who commands the Tropes—the very symbols of life—maintains the world’s order. Questioning the justice behind his own battles, ZAN embarks on a journey to uncover the truth, joined by Panther, a mechanical lifeform, and Uzume, the enigmatic girl who called out to him. She has an eternal fan in Koichi Okuta, who is always pouring heart and soul into supporting her. Normally, a fan would never get to interact with their idol beyond the stage. But one thing led to another, and Koichi now finds himself living together with Mizuki in his own house. He vows to make her the new Center of Melty Strawberry, sparking an unconventional tag-team between a devoted fan and his idol. Together, they attempt to elevate Mizuki's career from obscurity to stardom! (Source: K MANGA)

title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure
titleRomaji: Yuukyuu no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume
titleEnglish: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure
titleNative: 悠久の愚者アズリーの、賢者のすゝめ
synopsis: A couple thousand years of solitude would wear down any young man—that is, anyone except Asley, an eternally youthful and eternally foolish sorcerer. After all, he has man's best friend...er, familiar, to keep him company. When his Level 100 canine companion Pochi demands that he get some fresh air for the first time in two centuries, Asley sets out to reintegrate into society and test his magic mettle. His mission? Dropping several unglamorous titles from his repertoire and restoring his good (okay, decent) name. A brand-new world and fresh adventures await Asley after his many years of hermitage. Perhaps he'll lend Pochi a hand to place first in the mysterious Familiar Feud. Or maybe he'll lose all vestiges of dignity and turn tail. Whichever comes first! No matter what, Asley has great evil to fight, a big world to save, and even a little growing up to do...that is, if he can endure Pochi's “friendly advice” along the way! (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: DEATH STRANDING ISOLATIONS (Working Title)
synonyms: デス・ストランディング
synopsis: An original anime series based on the “Death Stranding” video game. Once, there was an explosion... Lonesome souls of the dead manifest in the physical world, reaching in search of the living. However, the connection they create triggers a massive explosion that eradicates anything of this world—a phenomenon referred to as the Death Stranding. These events wipe out nations as well as civilization itself. People who remain are now isolated, withdrawn, and without connections. As humanity stands at the brink a legendary porter set out to transport both cargo and wishes of its senders, reconnecting people in the hope that they might still be saved. Somewhere in North America, just as Sam Bridges walks through the continent in order to save America, the someones are also trying to deal with their isolation in their own way. An old man trying to realize salvation through ways outside of the connection advocated by Bridges. A female warrior who tries to kickstart a world of constant fighting

synopsis: Unpei Mochizuki had been working for two years as a spare parts dealer. After making a mistake, he had only one wish: to go far, where no one can recognize him. That’s when he crosses paths with Tsugumi Nagisa, illustrator… and nomad. A woman of indefinable age, who lives with her dog in a van. Unpei begins a new life on the road with Tsugumi and her car. Far from the usual tidy, sedentary lifestyle, the nomadic spirit offers new surprises every single day. From beaches to mountains, from the North to the South… Freedom and endless new landscapes await! (Source: Noeve grafx, translated)

synopsis: J is a professional hitman...he was orphan and raised by a syndicate as an assassin. He was too good, killed too many people, knew too much about the syndicate. When the syndicate tried to erase him, they were backfired...when three syndicates were wiped out completely, J became "untouchable." Megumi, a girl in third grade, was bullied by her classmates because she is half-Japanese, half-American and gets good grades. One day, when they bumped their heads...their bodies were switched. Now J is inside a cute girl's body...and Megumi is inside the tough guy's body. Now they must hide that they are not who they were and keep their everyday life look the same as before. titleRomaji: Shin no Seijo de aru Watashi wa Tsuihou Saremashita. Dakara Kono Kuni wa Mou Owari desu
titleNative: 真の聖女である私は追放されました。だからこの国はもう終わりです
synonyms: Because I, the True Saint, was Banished, that Country is Done For!
synopsis: “You are not the real saint, you’re nothing but a fake—!!!” I, Eliane, am suddenly exiled. Not only that, my engagement was also annulled by Claude, who was both my fiancé and the first prince of my country. Claude claims that Leticia is the ‘real saint’, but I know from the beginning, she is the woman he has been cheating on me with. So here I am, sharing his wish to cancel our engagement. But, is exiling me truly a wise decision, I wonder? Exiling this me, the actual ‘real saint’ who has been setting up barriers and supporting this kingdom from shadows? Maybe, just maybe, dragons and archdemons will invade my kingdom starting from tomorrow. Who knows— —not like it’s any of my business anymore. I have abandoned my own country and have thus decided to have a peaceful life. Meanwhile, the kingdom, which has lost its true saint, is on the path to ruin. (Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)
